_status: Star verdicts reviewed and approved for publication, 17 August 2026.

stars.reason_short: The case concerns how capability is measured, not who owns it.
The alliance keeps a metric it knows misreports what it claims to measure.
Belonging is not the axis this case turns on.
No question of which level should decide arises in this case.
No natural-monopoly infrastructure is at issue here.

stars.star_label: A Fair Deal Between Public and Private
stars.reason_short: Dual-use accounting is a measurement problem, not a risk-sharing bargain.
The metric rewards duplicated heavy platforms over the specialisation the star wants.
